definitions.explanation: The act of attaching, installing, or mounting equipment, fixtures, or appliances into place. Commonly used for air conditioners, shelves, lighting, and other household or industrial equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
{取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧2⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The installation work takes about 2 hours.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please read the installation manual carefully before starting work.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {取|と}り{付|つ}ける (to install, attach, mount). A very practical word for anyone living in Japan, since appliance installation ({取|と}り{付|つ}け) and removal ({取|と}り{外|はず}し) are common when moving into apartments — Japanese rentals often don't come with air conditioners or lighting fixtures pre-installed.

The word covers both professional installation services and DIY work. Online shopping sites often offer {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (installation service) as an add-on when purchasing appliances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: installation work
- {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{説明書|せつめいしょ}→説明書：19368_setsumeisho⟧: installation manual
- {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: installation method
- {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧: installation cost
- {取|と}り{付|つ}け⟦{位置|いち}→位置：11554_ichi⟧: mounting position

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧: installation, setup — more formal; used for larger systems, equipment, and facilities
- {取|と}り{外|はず}し: removal, detachment — the opposite action
- {据|す}え{付|つ}け: permanent installation — implies something fixed in place, harder to move
